method: Local Messages accessibility observation. sentAt is immediately before Return; lastAbsentAt is start of last snapshot without response; observedAt is completion of first snapshot with response. Millisecond Unix timestamps. Synthetic messages only. Same existing conversation; no history reset.

limitations: One sample per case, one existing conversation, sequential before/after design.
Repeated calibration prompts and growing conversation history affect cache/context; these are not independent randomized trials.
User-visible arrival bounds include all routing, inference and delivery time; they are not inference-only measurements.
Correctness scores measure requested visible reply; profile-memory side effects are recorded separately.
